newsitem.title: USA: MTS Systems buys German servo motor firm.
newsitem.headline: MTS Systems buys German servo motor firm.

text.p: MTS Systems Corp said Wednesday it completed the acquisition of Freiburg, Germany-based Bregenhorn-Butow & Co, a supplier of low power, electronic servo motors and drives.
The acquired company, which has annual revenues of about $8 million, will operate under the management of Custom Servo Motors, New Ulm, Minn., a subsidiary of MTS Systems.
The European offices of Custom Servo Motors GmbH will be relocated to the Bregenhorn-Butow facilities in Freiburg.

Custom Servo Motors president William Anderson said the acquisition will allow his company to penetrate the European market faster with its current line of high performance servo motors, drives and motion control products.
